title: Inertia arises from projected stress conservation

statements.text:
Projecting stress conservation orthogonal to the flow gives the relativistic Euler equation $(ho_t + p_t) a^\lambda = -h^{\lambda
u}

sources.quote: In this precise sense, inertia is not an extra postulate. It arises from projected stress conservation.
